items.title: Rejection, 35 U.S.C. 102
items.en: Claim(s) [1] is/are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 102 [2] as being [3] by [4].
items.zh: 权利要求 [1] 依 35 U.S.C. 102 [2] 被驳回，理由是被 [4] [3]。（[2] 填 (a)(1) 或 (a)(2)；[3] 通常填 anticipated 或 clearly anticipated）

items.title: Rejection, 35 U.S.C. 103
items.en: Claim [1] is/are rejected under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over [2].
items.zh: 权利要求 [1] 依 35 U.S.C. 103 被驳回，理由是相对于 [2] 不具备可专利性。
items.note: “unpatentable over D1 in view of D2” = 以 D1 为主、结合 D2。

items.title: Statutory basis, 35 U.S.C. 103
items.en: The following is a quotation of 35 U.S.C. 103 which forms the basis for all obviousness rejections set forth in this Office action:
items.zh: 以下引用的 35 U.S.C. 103 是本审查意见中所有显而易见性驳回的依据：

items.title: Written description
items.titleZh: 书面描述不足（含新内容）
items.en: Claim [1] rejected under 35 U.S.C. 112(a) or pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 112, first paragraph, as failing to comply with the written description requirement.
items.zh: 权利要求 [1] 依 35 U.S.C. 112(a)（AIA 前为 §112 第一段）被驳回，理由是不符合书面描述要求。
items.note: Also used for new matter in amendments — compare China Art. 33.

items.title: Written description — possession
items.en: The claim(s) contains subject matter which was not described in the specification in such a way as to reasonably convey to one skilled in the relevant art that the inventor or a joint inventor, or for applications subject to pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 112, the inventor(s), at the time the application was filed, had possession of the claimed invention.
items.zh: 该权利要求包含的主题，说明书没有以能够向相关领域技术人员合理表明以下事实的方式加以描述：在申请日时，发明人或共同发明人（适用 AIA 前 §112 的申请为发明人）已经占有所要求保护的发明。

items.title: Enablement
items.en: Claim [1] rejected under 35 U.S.C. 112(a) or pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 112, first paragraph, as failing to comply with the enablement requirement.
items.zh: 权利要求 [1] 依 35 U.S.C. 112(a)（AIA 前为第一段）被驳回，理由是不符合能够实现的要求。

items.title: Scope of enablement
items.en: Claim [1] rejected under 35 U.S.C. 112(a) or pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 112, first paragraph, because the specification, while being enabling for [2], does not reasonably provide enablement for [3].
items.zh: 权利要求 [1] 依 35 U.S.C. 112(a)（AIA 前为第一段）被驳回，因为说明书虽然对 [2] 能够实现，但不能合理地使 [3] 得以实现。
items.note: Closest to China’s 26(4) “not supported” objection for an over-broad claim.

items.title: Indefinite
items.en: Claim [1] rejected under 35 U.S.C. 112(b) or pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 112, second paragraph, as being indefinite for failing to particularly point out and distinctly claim the subject matter which the inventor or a joint inventor (or for applications subject to pre-AIA 35 U.S.C. 112, the applicant), regards as the invention.
items.zh: 权利要求 [1] 依 35 U.S.C. 112(b)（AIA 前为第二段）被驳回，理由是不清楚：未能具体指明并明确要求保护发明人或共同发明人（适用 AIA 前 §112 的申请为申请人）视为其发明的主题。
items.note: ≈ 中国 26 条 4 款“清楚”。

items.title: Essential subject matter missing from claims
items.titleZh: 权利要求缺少必要特征
items.en: The disclosure does not enable one of ordinary skill in the art to practice the invention without [2], which is/are critical or essential to the practice of the invention but not included in the claim(s).
items.zh: 缺少 [2] 时，本领域普通技术人员无法根据公开内容实施本发明；而 [2] 对实施本发明是关键或必要的，却未写入权利要求。
items.note: ≈ 中国“独立权利要求缺少必要技术特征”（专利法实施细则第二十三条第二款）。

items.title: § 101 judicial exception
items.en: the claimed invention is directed to [1] without significantly more.
items.zh: 所要求保护的发明指向 [1]（司法例外，如自然规律、自然产物），且没有显著更多的内容。

items.title: Basis for nonstatutory double patenting
items.titleZh: 非法定重复授权的依据
items.en: A nonstatutory double patenting rejection is appropriate where the conflicting claims are not identical, but at least one examined application claim is not patentably distinct from the reference claim(s) because the examined application claim is either anticipated by, or would have been obvious over, the reference claim(s).
items.zh: 当冲突的权利要求并不相同，但至少一项被审查的申请权利要求被参考权利要求预见、或相对于参考权利要求显而易见，因而与参考权利要求在可专利性上没有区别时，适合作出非法定重复授权驳回。
items.note: China has no obviousness-type double patenting; Art. 9 only bars the identical invention.

items.title: Nonstatutory double patenting rejection
items.en: Claim [1] rejected on the ground of nonstatutory double patenting as being unpatentable over claim [2] of U.S. Patent No. [3].
items.zh: 权利要求 [1] 以非法定重复授权为由被驳回，理由是相对于美国专利第 [3] 号的权利要求 [2] 不具备可专利性。
items.note: Overcome by a terminal disclaimer (期末放弃声明) when commonly owned.

items.title: Terminal disclaimer
items.en: The filing of a terminal disclaimer by itself is not a complete reply to a nonstatutory double patenting (NSDP) rejection.
items.zh: 仅提交期末放弃声明本身，并不构成对非法定重复授权（NSDP）驳回的完整答复。

items.title: Arguments not persuasive
items.en: Applicant’s arguments filed [1] have been fully considered but they are not persuasive.
items.zh: 申请人于 [1] 提交的意见已经充分考虑，但不具有说服力。
items.note: ≈ 申请人的意见陈述不具有说服力。

items.title: Arguments moot
items.titleZh: 意见因新理由而失去意义
items.en: Applicant’s arguments with respect to claim(s) [1] have been considered but are moot because the new ground of rejection does not rely on any reference applied in the prior rejection of record for any teaching or matter specifically challenged in the argument.
items.zh: 申请人针对权利要求 [1] 的意见已经考虑，但已无讨论必要，因为新的驳回理由并不依赖此前驳回中引用的、申请人在意见中具体质疑的任何文献教导或内容。

items.title: Arguments persuasive
items.en: Applicant’s arguments, see [ 1], filed [ 2], with respect to [ 3] have been fully considered and are persuasive.
items.zh: 申请人于 [2] 提交的关于 [3] 的意见（见 [1]）已经充分考虑，具有说服力。

items.title: Objected to — allowable if rewritten
items.titleZh: 从属权利要求可授权但需改写
items.en: Claim [1] objected to as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims.
items.zh: 权利要求 [1] 被提出反对，因为它从属于被驳回的基础权利要求；但如果改写为独立形式，并包含基础权利要求及任何中间权利要求的全部限定，则可以授权。
items.note: Rejected = 驳回（实质）；objected to = 提出反对（形式/从属问题）。

items.title: Specification lacks antecedent basis
items.titleZh: 说明书缺少对权利要求的支持用语
items.en: The specification is objected to as failing to provide proper antecedent basis for the claimed subject matter.
items.zh: 说明书被提出反对，理由是没有为所要求保护的主题提供恰当的引用基础。

items.title: Reasons for allowance
items.en: The following is an examiner’s statement of reasons for allowance: [1]
items.zh: 以下是审查员的授权理由说明：[1]

us.groupZh: 最终审查意见、RCE 与限制性要求

items.title: Action is final
items.titleZh: 本次审查意见为最终的
items.en: THIS ACTION IS MADE FINAL. Applicant is reminded of the extension of time policy as set forth in 37 CFR 1.136(a).
items.zh: 本次审查意见为最终审查意见。提醒申请人注意 37 CFR 1.136(a) 规定的延期政策。

items.title: Final action — time for reply
items.titleZh: 最终审查意见——答复期限
items.en: A shortened statutory period for reply to this final action is set to expire THREE MONTHS from the mailing date of this action.
items.zh: 对本最终审查意见的缩短法定答复期限，为自本意见发文日起三个月届满。
items.note: Extendable, but never later than SIX MONTHS from the mailing date (same form paragraph).

items.title: Final, necessitated by amendment
items.titleZh: 因修改导致的最终审查意见
items.en: Applicant’s amendment necessitated the new ground(s) of rejection presented in this Office action. Accordingly, THIS ACTION IS MADE FINAL.
items.zh: 本审查意见中提出的新驳回理由是由申请人的修改导致的。因此，本次审查意见为最终的。

items.title: RCE after final
items.titleZh: 最终审查意见后的继续审查请求
items.en: Since this application is eligible for continued examination under 37 CFR 1.114, and the fee set forth in 37 CFR 1.17(e) has been timely paid, the finality of the previous Office action has been withdrawn pursuant to 37 CFR 1.114.
items.zh: 由于本申请符合 37 CFR 1.114 规定的继续审查条件，且已按时缴纳 37 CFR 1.17(e) 规定的费用，根据 37 CFR 1.114，此前审查意见的最终性已被撤销。

items.title: Election of species
items.en: Applicant is required under 35 U.S.C. 121 to elect a single disclosed species, or a single grouping of patentably indistinct species, for prosecution on the merits to which the claims shall be restricted if no generic claim is finally held to be allowable.
items.zh: 根据 35 U.S.C. 121，申请人须选择一个已公开的物种，或一组在可专利性上无区别的物种，进行实质审查；如果最终没有上位权利要求被认定可授权，权利要求将被限制在所选物种上。
items.note: Very common for Markush (马库什) claims in pharma.

items.title: Restriction — burden
items.en: Restriction for examination purposes as indicated is proper because all the inventions listed in this action are independent or distinct for the reasons given above and there would be a serious search and/or examination burden if restriction were not required because one or more of the following reasons apply:
items.zh: 如上所示，为审查目的提出限制性要求是恰当的，因为基于上述理由，本意见列出的所有发明彼此独立或不同；并且由于存在以下一种或多种原因，如不提出限制性要求将造成检索和/或审查的严重负担：

cn.group: 新颖性 / 创造性评述

items.zh: 权利要求1请求保护一种……。对比文件1公开了一种……，并具体公开了以下技术特征：……
items.en: Claim 1 claims a …. D1 discloses a … and specifically discloses the following technical features: ….

items.zh: 权利要求1所要求保护的技术方案已被对比文件1公开，二者属于同样的发明，因此权利要求1不具备专利法第二十二条第二款规定的新颖性。
items.en: The technical solution of claim 1 has been disclosed in D1, and the two are the identical invention; claim 1 therefore lacks novelty under Article 22, paragraph 2, of the Patent Law.

items.zh: 权利要求1与对比文件1的区别技术特征在于：……
items.en: Claim 1 differs from D1 in the following distinguishing technical feature: ….

items.zh: 基于上述区别技术特征，权利要求1实际解决的技术问题是：如何……
items.en: On the basis of this distinguishing feature, the technical problem actually solved by claim 1 is how to ….

items.zh: 对比文件2公开了……，且该技术特征在对比文件2中所起的作用与其在本申请中为解决上述技术问题所起的作用相同，即对比文件2给出了将该技术特征应用于对比文件1以解决其技术问题的启示。
items.en: D2 discloses …, and this feature plays the same role in D2 as it does in the present application in solving the above problem; that is, D2 suggests applying this feature to D1 to solve its technical problem.

items.zh: 该区别技术特征属于本领域的惯用技术手段。
items.en: The distinguishing feature is a customary technical means in the art.

items.zh: 在对比文件1的基础上结合对比文件2和本领域的公知常识，得到权利要求1所要求保护的技术方案，对本领域的技术人员来说是显而易见的。
items.en: Starting from D1 and combining it with D2 and the common general knowledge in the art, it would be obvious to a person skilled in the art to arrive at the technical solution of claim 1.

items.zh: 因此，权利要求1不具有突出的实质性特点和显著的进步，不具备专利法第二十二条第三款规定的创造性。
items.en: Claim 1 therefore does not have prominent substantive features and does not represent obvious progress, and lacks inventiveness under Article 22, paragraph 3, of the Patent Law.

items.zh: 从属权利要求2对权利要求1作了进一步限定，其附加技术特征已被对比文件1公开；因此，在其引用的权利要求不具备创造性时，权利要求2也不具备创造性。
items.en: Dependent claim 2 further limits claim 1, and its additional technical feature has been disclosed in D1; since the claim it refers to is not inventive, claim 2 is not inventive either.

items.zh: 申请人没有提供证据证明该技术特征能够带来预料不到的技术效果。
items.en: The applicant has not provided evidence that this feature brings about an unexpected technical effect.

items.zh: 说明书仅记载了化合物A和B的实验数据，本领域技术人员难以预见通式中其他化合物也能达到相同的效果。
items.en: The description provides experimental data only for compounds A and B; a person skilled in the art could not foresee that the other compounds of the general formula would achieve the same effect.

items.zh: 因此，权利要求1得不到说明书的支持，不符合专利法第二十六条第四款的规定。
items.en: Claim 1 is therefore not supported by the description and does not comply with Article 26, paragraph 4, of the Patent Law.

items.zh: 说明书未记载任何证明化合物X具有所述活性的实验数据，所属技术领域的技术人员无法确认其能够解决所述技术问题，因此说明书公开不充分，不符合专利法第二十六条第三款的规定。
items.en: The description contains no experimental data showing that compound X has the stated activity, so a person skilled in the art cannot confirm that it solves the technical problem; the invention is therefore insufficiently disclosed, contrary to Article 26, paragraph 3, of the Patent Law.

items.zh: 权利要求1中的“约”使其保护范围不清楚。
items.en: The word “about” in claim 1 makes the scope of protection unclear.

items.zh: 权利要求3中的“所述载体”缺乏引用基础。
items.en: “The carrier” in claim 3 lacks antecedent basis.

items.zh: 修改后的权利要求1增加了技术特征“……”，该特征在原说明书和权利要求书中没有记载，也不能从中直接地、毫无疑义地确定。
items.en: Amended claim 1 adds the feature “…”, which is not recorded in the original description and claims and cannot be directly and unambiguously derived from them.

items.zh: 因此，上述修改超出了原说明书和权利要求书记载的范围，不符合专利法第三十三条的规定。
items.en: The amendment therefore goes beyond the scope of disclosure contained in the original description and claims and does not comply with Article 33 of the Patent Law.

items.zh: 申请人在意见陈述中认为……。审查员不同意申请人的意见，理由如下：……
items.en: In the observations the applicant argues that …. The examiner does not agree, for the following reasons: ….

items.zh: 要求其在指定的期限内陈述意见，或者对其申请进行修改；无正当理由逾期不答复的，该申请即被视为撤回。
items.en: require him or it to state opinions within a specified time limit or to amend the application. If the applicant fails to state opinions at the expiration of the specified time limit without any justified reason, the application shall be deemed to have been withdrawn.

items.zh: 基于上述理由，本申请的独立权利要求及从属权利要求均不具备创造性，说明书中也没有记载其他可以授予专利权的实质性内容，因而即使申请人对权利要求进行重新组合和/或根据说明书记载的内容作进一步限定，本申请也不具备被授予专利权的前景。
items.en: For the above reasons, neither the independent nor the dependent claims are inventive, and the description contains no other substantive matter that could be patented. Even if the claims were recombined and/or further limited by matter in the description, the application would have no prospect of being granted.

reply.zh: 申请人对该驳回理由恭敬地提出异议。

reply.en: Claim 1 has been amended to recite “…”. Support for the amendment can be found at least in paragraph [0045] and Example 3 of the specification as filed. No new matter has been added.
reply.zh: 权利要求 1 已修改为记载“……”。该修改至少可以在原始说明书第 [0045] 段和实施例 3 中找到依据，未加入新内容。

reply.en: The cited references, alone or in combination, fail to teach or suggest each and every limitation of amended claim 1.
reply.zh: 所引文献单独或组合都没有教导或启示修改后权利要求 1 的每一项限定。

reply.en: The Office action has not articulated a reason why a person of ordinary skill in the art would have combined D1 and D2 with a reasonable expectation of success.
reply.zh: 审查意见没有说明本领域普通技术人员为什么会组合 D1 和 D2，并且有合理的成功预期。

reply.en: D1 teaches away from the claimed invention because …
reply.zh: D1 教导了相反的方向（与要求保护的发明相背离），因为……

reply.en: The Declaration under 37 CFR 1.132 submitted herewith shows unexpected results that are commensurate in scope with the claims.
reply.zh: 随附的 37 CFR 1.132 声明显示了与权利要求范围相称的预料不到的效果。

reply.en: Reconsideration and withdrawal of the rejection are respectfully requested.
reply.zh: 恳请重新考虑并撤回该驳回。

reply.en: Applicant elects, with traverse, Group I (claims 1–10) and the species of compound 12.
reply.zh: 申请人有异议地选择第 I 组（权利要求 1–10）以及化合物 12 这一物种。

reply.en: Applicant submits herewith a terminal disclaimer over U.S. Patent No. ….
reply.zh: 申请人随附提交针对美国专利第……号的期末放弃声明。

reply.en: The Examiner is invited to telephone the undersigned if an interview would advance prosecution.
reply.zh: 如会晤有助于推进审查，敬请审查员致电下列签署人。
